limits: Recorded hashes are launcher hashes of prepared script files, not runtime attestation of every loaded script. All seven A/B changed production scripts are covered.
RenderingServer viewport measurements are existing render counters, may lag, do not cover all GDScript or submission/wait/scheduling and must not be added as a complete frame decomposition.
ProcessTimes is process-wide across threads over the entire sample window, not per-frame CPU attribution.
All acceptance phases arrays are empty (profile=false); ordinary-frame CPU execution versus submission/wait remains unresolved.
